Thu 04 Dec

Heavers Farm Primary School

Celebrate 10 years of Bright Futures 4 All with a festive Caribbean twist! Enjoy a two-course Caribbean meal, live steelpan, Christmas carols, games, auctions, raffles, and a 10th Anniversary gift bag — all while supporting our Youth Development & Leadership Programmes.

04 Dec 2025, 12:00 – 17:00

Heavers Farm Primary School, 58 Dinsdale Gardens, London SE25 6LT, UK

Join us for a vibrant Caribbean-inspired Christmas Market and Luncheon as we celebrate 10 incredible years of service to the community!

This joyful celebration combines the warmth of the Caribbean with the magic of Christmas — featuring a delicious two-course Caribbean meal , soft drinks , a 10th Anniversary gift bag , and unforgettable entertainment including Christmas carols, live steelpan music, festive games with prizes, auctions, and raffles.

Every ticket purchased helps raise vital funds to support our Youth Development & Leadership Programmes — empowering young people through 10 extraordinary activities that mark our decade of impact and growth.
